limitations.aggregate_only: No individual compounds or hidden/pending outcomes are available.
limitations.commercial_rights_unconfirmed: Commercial/raw-data redistribution clearance is not established.
limitations.development_only: Exposed development evidence, not independent biological confirmation.
limitations.mechanical_d_equals_h: Round-robin D=H is mechanical at these budgets.
limitations.missing_excluded: Missing confirmation is excluded, never treated as inactive.
limitations.no_lab_or_clinical_value: No measured laboratory savings, prospective efficacy or clinical benefit.
limitations.no_rl_result: CF1 did not evaluate RL; the simulator is a separate retrospective study.
limitations.nonpositive_mixed: Source nonpositive includes inactive and inconclusive.
limitations.one_component: Six campaigns share one annotation-connected component.
limitations.seed_range_not_ci: Five-seed ranges are conditional repetitions, not biological confidence intervals.
